main_measure.name: t of the OLS slope of excess 48-bar return on forecast, Friday 00:00 cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t >= 2 with forecast-weighted mean excess > 0; reject: t <= -2

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Cases are bars whose close (timestamp + 1h) is Friday 00:00 UTC with forecast > 0 and a full 48-row forward return inside the window; the coin's mean 48-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows pooled; one pooled OLS across all coins.
